[[Lady/Legends|Lady]] '''Viopa''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as a [[Starfighter/Legends|Starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|Pilot]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="swg" />
